# jstack

> Claude Code skills and scripts for shipping the work of many parallel AI coding agents from one machine: a merge train (/train) that verifies many git worktree branches with one build and one PR, a machine-wide heavy-job lock so parallel builds don't run out of RAM, and a web performance skill (/optimize) that proves fixes with A/B statistics.

Install as a Claude Code plugin with `/plugin marketplace add jayjayholic/jstack` and `/plugin install jstack@jstack`, or copy the files and follow ADAPT.md. Everything machine-specific is a `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` in the skills or a `JSTACK_*` env var for the scripts.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/README.md): what it is, why it exists, quickstart, FAQ
- [ADAPT.md](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/ADAPT.md): step-by-step guide for an agent to fit jstack to any stack, with every placeholder and how to find its value
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/AGENTS.md): notes for coding agents installing or changing this repo
- [HOW-I-WORK.md](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/HOW-I-WORK.md): the workflow around it (grilled plans, prototypes, A/B everything, /simplify)

## Skills

- [/train](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/train/SKILL.md): merge train for parallel agents: one orchestrator, one typecheck, one build, one PR, merge on green
- [/train-queue](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/train-queue/SKILL.md): read-only status board of the train: live, in flight, queue, what each agent is doing
- [/grill-me](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md) and [/grilling](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/grilling/SKILL.md): Matt Pocock's plan interview, copied as-is (MIT)
- [/wayfinder](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md): Matt Pocock's planning map of decision tickets, copied as-is (MIT), with the skills it calls: research, prototype, domain-modeling, setup-matt-pocock-skills
- [orchestrator brief](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/train/orchestrator-brief.md): prompt for the orchestrator agent
- [worker clause](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/train/worker-clause.md): block pasted into every coding agent's prompt
- [/optimize](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/optimize/SKILL.md): measure LCP, INP, TTFB, long tasks, API waterfall and bundle size, fix the top cost, prove it with interleaved A/B runs
- [PERFORMANCE.md](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/skills/optimize/PERFORMANCE.md): sourced performance know-how for /optimize: method, number-vetting checklist, metric targets, trace recipes per layer, instant-UI techniques, cases

## Plugins

- [jay-claude-switcher](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/plugins/jay-claude-switcher/README.md): Claude Code side panel with every stored Claude account's 5-hour and weekly usage and an auto-switch to the least-used account at 99%; switch.py command line and an add-account skill. Install: `/plugin install jay-claude-switcher --marketplace jayjayholic/jstack`

## Scripts

- [heavy-lock.sh](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/heavy-lock.sh): one machine-wide slot for builds and typechecks, server_wait, heavy_capped (hard RAM ceiling for a build's whole process tree) and tc_run (a capped typecheck lane for worker agents)
- [run-capped.ps1](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/run-capped.ps1): Windows Job Object memory cap behind heavy_capped
- [train.sh](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/train.sh): assemble, build and ship a train
- [new-worktree.sh](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/new-worktree.sh): one ready-to-run git worktree per agent
- [config.example.sh](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/config.example.sh): every setting in one file

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed and why
- [coordinator-build.sh](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/coordinator-build.sh): one capped build at a time
- [node-memory-watch.ps1](https://github.com/jayjayholic/jstack/blob/main/tools/node-memory-watch.ps1): Windows memory watcher that kills runaway node/bun processes
